requirements.description: Energy class C or better, as requested by the user. Non-energy criteria (Turin location, minimum 850 sqm gross floor area, capacity for 60 people, office-to-student-residence conversion, CDP/PNRR funding) are outside the energy scope and were not turned into filters.
Student residence for university students: schools and universities must be nearby. Set at the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75).

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct >= filter on surface_area. The 60-person capacity is not converted into an area requirement because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class (C or better) and the CDP/PNRR funding context are outside the reference columns and are not filtered.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND education >= 75 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters the ESTATES table to office-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 sqm, energy_class in A1-A4, B or C, education score >= 75, and within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km. Results are ordered by distance from that point, nearest first. The 60-person capacity was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not applied.
